roles.drugs: urate-lowering: allopurinol (start ≤100 mg daily, lower in CKD stage ≥3, eg ≤50 mg; titrate to urate <6 mg/dL, up to 800 mg). ACR conditionally recommends HLA-B*5801 testing before allopurinol in patients of Southeast Asian descent (eg, Han Chinese, Korean, Thai) and African American patients (ACR 2020)
